dsfd_mtp_hrow.summary: Hidden-row store for the MTP seed: keeps main-model hidden rows per user and position (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_mtp_hrow.about: On the DSpark primary die. Receives the main model's hidden rows from the dies holding layers 37-39 over dedicated lanes, stores them in 120 SRAMs as slots versioned by user, position and epoch, and serves them to the seed launcher. Built from 30 bank tiles.

dsfd_mtp_hrow_bank.summary: One bank tile of the MTP hidden-row store: 4 SRAMs around a register channel (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_mtp_hrow_bank.about: One of 30 identical bank tiles of dsfd_mtp_hrow. Holds four 1024x256 SRAMs around a register channel, with registered inputs, capture and outputs.

dsfd_mtp_seed_launch.summary: DSpark primary-die seed launcher: turns a seed descriptor into a drafter start (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_mtp_seed_launch.about: Receives the seed descriptor from the head-die MTP sequencer over the collective's dedicated MTP lane, drops stale or duplicate seeds, fetches the committed hidden rows, streams them to the seed control and starts the draft program.

dsfd_mtp_seq.summary: Head-die MTP sequencer: accepts verified tokens and drives the draft chain (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_mtp_seq.about: Sits on the head die's result stream between the head controller and the token-return link to the source WFC. Performs greedy prefix acceptance of draft tokens, sends the seed to the drafter dies, runs the five draft-head steps and writes the new draft block into the WFC token store.

dsfd_mtp_seq_rtt.summary: MTP sequencer with link receivers sized for the full relay-station round trip (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_mtp_seq_rtt.about: Same function and ports as dsfd_mtp_seq, with its grant receivers sized for the real number of relay stations on the head-die links. The smaller receivers in dsfd_mtp_seq could overflow under sustained traffic.

dsfd_p2_lnk.summary: Link ends at the P2 MTP draft core pins: round-trip-sized receivers + start gate (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_p2_lnk.about: Sits at the pins of the P2 selected-path draft core on draft die A and converts its valid/ready buses into the MTP grant protocol across the die's relay stations. Receivers are sized to each stationed round trip, and a transaction gate admits lane words only under the start they belong to. Partners: dsfd_coll_p2_ep (collective slab) and the VM slab endpoint.

dsfd_r2l_vr_1024x1__ha_SW.summary: Brings SW scan-service attention output and index back into vector memory, ratio CDC (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_r2l_vr_1024x1__ha_SW.about: r2l end block beside the vector memory (VM): receives the 1,024-bit attention-output plus index stream from the SW HBM stack's scan service on a 1.2 GHz forwarded chain and crosses it into the VM's 0.9 GHz serial domain through a 4:3 ratio clock-domain-crossing FIFO.

dsfd_r2l_vr_512x1__hcol.summary: Brings banked-collector results into vector memory, 1.2-to-0.9 GHz ratio CDC (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_r2l_vr_512x1__hcol.about: r2l end block on the east side of the vector memory: receives the 512-bit result stream from the banked collector (N band) over a forwarded chain through the vertical channel and crosses it into the VM's serial domain.

dsfd_r2l_vr_512x1__hsel.summary: Brings selector results into vector memory, 1.2-to-0.9 GHz ratio CDC (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_r2l_vr_512x1__hsel.about: r2l end block on the east side of the vector memory: receives the 512-bit result stream from the selector (S band, indexer top-k) over a forwarded chain and crosses it into the VM's serial domain.

dsfd_selt_c.summary: Selector control tile: top-k control, per-quarter landing FIFOs and ordered output merge (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_selt_c.about: Centre tile of the selector slab, abutted by the four select-quarter tiles. Runs the top-k selection control and segment header/tag/fault logic, lands each quarter's results in a credited FIFO, merges them in quarter order and paces the output word stream to the VM.

dsfd_selt_q2.summary: Selector quarter tile: streaming top-k slice for one HBM scan service, with SRAMs (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_selt_q2.about: One of four select-quarter tiles around dsfd_selt_c, each fed by one HBM stack's scan service. Decodes the incoming score lane and runs an exact streaming top-k slice with six 128x256 line-memory SRAMs; this variant registers the macro outputs.

dsfd_sp_hc_cmd_bridge_pf.summary: Test fixture for the HC slab's command bridge from the stage sequencer (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_sp_hc_cmd_bridge_pf.about: A standalone physical pathfinding fixture, not a production block. It wraps the bridge that converts stage-sequencer engine commands into the HC slab's capture commands (user, position, epoch) and returns done/fault, to see how it times before integration.

dsfd_stnh_512x1.summary: 512-bit forwarded-clock repeater station on long die chains, horizontal pin faces (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_stnh_512x1.about: One forwarded-link stage for a 512-bit slice, registered at both faces: captures data with the incoming forwarded clock and re-launches data and clock to the next hop. Placed every few hundred microns along long point-to-point chains, here raw 512-bit die-link chains (collective to/from the link macros); horizontal variant of the station.

dsfd_stnh_514x1.summary: 514-bit forwarded-clock repeater station on long die chains, horizontal pin faces (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_stnh_514x1.about: One forwarded-link stage for a 514-bit slice, registered at both faces: captures data with the incoming forwarded clock and re-launches data and clock to the next hop. Placed every few hundred microns along long point-to-point chains, here valid-framed 512-bit chains (query, selector/collector, scan-service streams); horizontal variant of the station.

dsfd_stnh_566x1.summary: 566-bit forwarded-clock repeater station on long die chains, horizontal pin faces (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_stnh_566x1.about: One forwarded-link stage for a 566-bit slice, registered at both faces: captures data with the incoming forwarded clock and re-launches data and clock to the next hop. Placed every few hundred microns along long point-to-point chains, here the 566-bit activation (x) broadcast trunks; horizontal variant of the station.

dsfd_stnv_512x1.summary: 512-bit forwarded-clock repeater station on long die chains, vertical pin faces (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_stnv_512x1.about: One forwarded-link stage for a 512-bit slice, registered at both faces: captures data with the incoming forwarded clock and re-launches data and clock to the next hop. Placed every few hundred microns along long point-to-point chains, here raw 512-bit chains; vertical variant of the station.

dsfd_stnv_514x1.summary: 514-bit forwarded-clock repeater station on long die chains, vertical pin faces (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_stnv_514x1.about: One forwarded-link stage for a 514-bit slice, registered at both faces: captures data with the incoming forwarded clock and re-launches data and clock to the next hop. Placed every few hundred microns along long point-to-point chains, here valid-framed 512-bit chains (query, selector/collector, scan-service streams); vertical variant of the station.

dsfd_su_t_ctl.summary: Stream-unit control tile: engine adapter, clock crossing and job control (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_su_t_ctl.about: Control tile of the hierarchical SU slab. Receives jobs from the stage sequencer through the engine adapter (with its clock-domain crossing) and sequences each job across the engine tiles.

dsfd_su_t_kv0.summary: Stream-unit kv-norm head tile: kv RMSNorm with RoPE and FP8 quant/dequant (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_su_t_kv0.about: Head tile of the KV lane group in the SU slab: kv RMSNorm (sum-of-squares rung), then RoPE on the tail and FP8 quantise/dequantise; paired with lane tile dsfd_su_t_kv1.

dsfd_su_t_kv1.summary: Stream-unit kv-norm lane tile: kv RMSNorm and RoPE lanes (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_su_t_kv1.about: Lane tile of the KV group in the SU slab, holding the per-lane kv RMSNorm and RoPE datapath; paired with the head tile dsfd_su_t_kv0.

dsfd_su_t_pin.summary: Stream-unit pin-owner tile: 4 vector memory read and 4 write slots (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_su_t_pin.about: One of the pin-owner tiles of the SU slab. Owns a group of the slab's vector memory pins (4 read and 4 write row slots) and registers them between the VM and the slab's spines.

dsfd_su_t_qb.summary: Stream-unit activation-quant bank tile (FP8/FP4), one of four (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_su_t_qb.about: One of four QB lane tiles in the SU slab. Quantises activations block by block to FP8 or FP4 (attention and indexer inputs), reading rows from the down-spine and writing through registered write slots.

dsfd_su_t_qn0.summary: Stream-unit q-norm head tile: RMSNorm of q followed by FP8 quantisation (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_su_t_qn0.about: Head tile of the QN lane group in the SU slab: computes the q RMSNorm (including the registered sum-of-squares) and FP8 activation quantisation, working with the QN lane tile dsfd_su_t_qn1.

dsfd_su_t_qn1.summary: Stream-unit q-norm lane tile: RMSNorm lanes for q before FP8 quantisation (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_su_t_qn1.about: Lane tile of the QN group in the SU slab, holding the per-lane datapath of the q RMSNorm and FP8 quantisation; paired with the head tile dsfd_su_t_qn0.

dsfd_su_t_root.summary: Root tile of the stream-unit slab: engine adapter, VM pin registers and control (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_su_t_root.about: Root tile of the hierarchical SU slab (dsfd_sp_su_h). Holds the engine adapter to the stage sequencer, the registers on the vector memory pins and job control, and drives the spines that feed the engine tiles.

dsfd_su_t_sm.summary: Stream-unit softmax tile: attention scores to probabilities and normalisation, one of eight (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_su_t_sm.about: One of eight SM tiles in the SU slab. Computes the attention softmax (max, exponent, denominator, sink) and later normalises P.V output and applies inverse RoPE.

dsfd_su_t_sw.summary: Stream-unit SwiGLU tile: SwiGLU, routing weight and act-quant, one of eight (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_su_t_sw.about: One of eight SW lane tiles in the SU slab. Computes the MoE expert SwiGLU, applies the routing weight and quantises the result for the next matmul.

dsfd_svc_join.summary: Single job endpoint that fans job descriptors to every scan-service slab and joins dones (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_svc_join.about: The die controller's scan-service engine command endpoint: a pinned adapter queue that sends each job descriptor as a pulse to every HBM stack's scan-service slab and completes the head job only when all slabs report done, in order. Flags a fault on any slab fault or an unexpected done; talks to each slab's dsfd_svcio_job tile.

dsfd_svc_pc.summary: Per-pseudo-channel HBM interface tile of a scan service, one register each way (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_svc_pc.about: One of 32 tiles in a row along the scan service's south face, each abutted to the HBM controller tile of the same pseudo-channel. It registers the quadrant's read/write requests toward the controller and the read responses and completion pulses back up to the quadrant above (8 PCs per quadrant).

dsfd_svc_stn.summary: Link station inside a scan service carrying query and results between quadrant and IO hub (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_svc_stn.about: Pipeline station chained every ~430 um inside the scan-service slab between a quadrant and the IO hub. It registers the 515-bit query stream going to the quadrant and two 512-bit result streams (od, a0) coming back through 2-slot skid buffers; +1 cycle per station, full throughput.

dsfd_svch_pcs.summary: Per-pseudo-channel service slice of a scan-service quadrant: arbitrates HBM requests (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_svch_pcs.about: Hardened slice of the hierarchical scan service, one per HBM pseudo-channel (8 per quadrant), sitting directly above that PC's controller tile. It arbitrates requests from the index reader, window stream and quadrant hub lanes onto the PC with a pipelined 3-way arbiter, tracks DRAM credits, and returns read data and write completions to each lane.

dsfd_svch_rly.summary: Relay register station on the scan-service slab's internal seams (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_svch_rly.about: Register station for the hierarchical scan-service slab: a chain of register stages on a bundle of valid and data bits with its own synchronised reset, placed every ~450 um along seam paths between the slab's sub-blocks (the widest is the window-beat lane).

dsfd_svcio_ad.summary: Scan-service IO hub tile merging quadrant attention results onto the ad pins (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_svcio_ad.about: One of four IO hub tiles of a scan service, placed at its die pin group. It merges the quadrants' a0 result streams and the a1 stream (through pin-registered queues) onto the ad output with its forwarded clock af, and holds the slab's sticky fault flag.

dsfd_svcio_job.summary: Per-slab job tile gating scan-service query frames by job and tracking result frames (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_svcio_job.about: Sits at the scan-service IO hub beside dsfd_svcio_q, between the die q pin and the q tile. It passes a query frame only while the matching job is armed (else discards it and sets a fault), and observes the end-of-frame markers on the hub's output streams to report per-job done/fault back to dsfd_svc_join.

dsfd_svcio_od.summary: Scan-service IO hub tile merging quadrant od result streams onto the die pins (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_svcio_od.about: One of four IO hub tiles of a scan service, at its own die pin group: frame-atomic merge of the four quadrants' od result streams (each through a pin-registered queue) onto the od output with its forwarded clock.

dsfd_svcio_q.summary: Scan-service IO hub tile registering the query input and fanning it to four quadrants (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_svcio_q.about: One of four IO hub tiles of a scan service, at the q pin group: registers the 515-bit incoming query stream at the pins and drives four kept replicas, one per quadrant, onto the station chains.

dsfd_svcio_x.summary: Scan-service IO hub tile driving the x result stream onto the die pins (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_svcio_x.about: One of four IO hub tiles of a scan service: a skid buffer that takes the slab's x stream and drives it onto the xd output pins with its forwarded clock xf.

dsfd_vm_be.summary: Vector memory back end: response side to every client, plus status (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_vm_be.about: Sits on the south side of the VM bank-group columns and returns read responses to clients (WFC, control, bus lanes, the MTP P2 lane FIFO) and reports status. Composed of four hardened bit-slice tiles (dsfd_vm_be_sl) and a thin parent of registered control, reset and status relays.

dsfd_vm_be_sl.summary: One 128-bit slice tile of the vector memory back end (4 per back end) (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_vm_be_sl.about: One of four identical tiles of dsfd_vm_be, each placed under one bank-group column and handling that column's 128-bit slice of read responses, including the clock-domain crossing and the P2 lane FIFO slice.

dsfd_vm_bgq.summary: Vector memory bank-group tile: one 128-bit slice of every row, 8 SRAM macros (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_vm_bgq.about: Bit-sliced bank-group tile of the vector memory; columns of these tiles form the banked memory, each tile holding 128 bits of every row. Requests and read data pass tile to tile through registered pins with fixed latency, keeping the memory's global issue order.

dsfd_vm_bgq28.summary: 28-port version of the vector memory bank-group tile used by the v3 VM master (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_vm_bgq28.about: The vector memory bank-group tile (dsfd_vm_bgq) built with 28 ports: 16 write-only capture lanes, 2 landing drains and 10 read/write ports. It is the banked memory tile of the current VM master, between the front end (dsfd_vm_fe) above and the back end (dsfd_vm_be) below.

dsfd_vm_clt.summary: Capture-lane tile of the vector memory front end (16 per front end) (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_vm_clt.about: One of 16 identical hardened lane tiles abutted inside dsfd_vm_fe. Registers one slice of the capture stream and pipelines that lane's landing logic before the request enters the VM banks; the lane index is a strap pin so all 16 share one hardened view.

dsfd_vm_fe.summary: Vector memory front end: request side of every client, capture landing, ordering (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_vm_fe.about: Sits on the north side of the VM bank-group columns. Takes every client's request, the 16-lane capture landing and landing FIFOs, the shared order register, the row-completion counter and the engine adapter, and issues ordered requests into the banks. Built from hardened capture-lane tiles (dsfd_vm_clt).

dsfd_vm_mtp_ep.summary: VM-slab end of the MTP sequencer links: draft-head step receiver and result senders (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_vm_mtp_ep.about: Partner endpoint on the vector memory slab for the head-die MTP sequencer (dsfd_mtp_seq_rtt). Receives draft-head step data and sends rows-ready and draft-head results back, using grant-based link ends sized for the relay-station round trip.

dsfd_vm_p2_ep.summary: VM-slab transmitter for MTP P2 lane 0, sending draft-path data off the VM (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_vm_p2_ep.about: VM-side end of P2 lane 0, a dedicated MTP lane between DSpark dies. Launches one flit per grant it has seen, so it stays correct across the relay stations on that lane.

dsfd_vm_wfc_ep.summary: VM-side endpoint of the wavefront controller's vector memory channels (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_vm_wfc_ep.about: Receives the WFC kit's write/read requests over the stationed die link, runs them in order into one VM port, returns read data, and raises the stage-core START doorbell only after the preceding writes. Reports sticky error status back to the WFC.

dsfd_wfc_crp.summary: WFC credit port tile: lands die-link data in SRAM and returns credits (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_wfc_crp.about: Sits in the WFC slab between the die's station chains and the WFC kit. Lands incoming link beats in an SRAM FIFO (3 macros, 32 deep), returns one credit per pop, and flags a sticky fault on overflow.

dsfd_wfc_lnk.summary: WFC link bridge between the die-to-die link and the WFC, with draft diversion (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_wfc_lnk.about: Converts between the die link's valid/ready protocol and the WFC's grant protocol. Diverts MTP DRAFT flits into the token store and issues vector memory write credits, so each payload flit becomes one VM write.

dsfd_wfc_tok_hard.summary: WFC token store lookup: tells the WFC whether a (user, position) token is known (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_wfc_tok_hard.about: Hardened version of the WFC's token/draft store lookup. Reads a 16-slot bank, selects among 8 users and returns whether the token at a position is known (a prompt token or a current MTP draft) so the WFC can issue it.

dsfd_wfc_vmx.summary: WFC transport to vector memory and stage core across the 1.2/0.9 GHz clock boundary (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsfd_wfc_vmx.about: Carries the WFC's payload writes, START and DONE between the fast streaming domain and the slower VM/stage-core domain. Keeps them in order so a start cannot overtake its writes and the outbound payload is read only after done.

dsrom_mtp_head_full340_A.summary: Markov MTP draft head: lm_head dot product plus Markov term, argmax over vocab slice (DeepSeek ROM die)
dsrom_mtp_head_full340_A.about: Production head-die Markov head of the DeepSeek-V4.1 MTP drafter. For the die's slice of the vocabulary it computes lm_head and Markov-head scores and a first-max argmax, merged across dies. Built from 85 bundles (340 engines); its hardened part is the bundle glue element.

hfd_att_su_relay.summary: Relay station carrying attention-root outputs to the stream-unit lanes (HBM accelerator)
hfd_att_su_relay.about: One registered relay of the 529-bit attention-root to stream-unit lane bus (data plus valid). A chain of these carries each attention output row to its SU lane; the bus never back-pressures, so the relay is just a pin-to-pin register.

hfd_attn_half_hi.summary: High half of the attention tile: QK/PV over HBM KV rows (HBM accelerator)
hfd_attn_half_hi.about: The top half-block of the split attention tile (the upper row of compute quads and result banks). It pairs with hfd_attn_half_lo, which holds the root that collects outputs toward the stream unit.

hfd_attn_half_lo.summary: Low half of the attention tile: QK/PV over HBM KV rows, holds the root (HBM accelerator)
hfd_attn_half_lo.about: The bottom half-block of the split attention tile. It holds the input sources and the result root and pairs with hfd_attn_half_hi; together they compute QK scores and PV products over KV rows streamed from HBM.

hfd_cmdproc_n.summary: North band of the command processor, the die's in-order program sequencer (HBM accelerator)
hfd_cmdproc_n.about: The north band of the split command processor. It drives commands to the north-side engines and stream-unit quarters (NE/NW faces) and handles the barrier at the north edge; commands and doorbells arrive from the south band.

hfd_cmdproc_s.summary: South band of the command processor, the die's in-order program sequencer (HBM accelerator)
hfd_cmdproc_s.about: The south band of the split command processor. It receives commands/doorbells and the loader interface, forwards loader and barrier bits to the north band, and collects the south-side matrix-engine barrier arrivals.

hfd_coll.summary: Collective engine: cross-die all-reduce, all-gather, top-k/argmax merge, row gather (HBM accelerator)
hfd_coll.about: The die's collective engine endpoint. It takes reduce/gather work from the stream unit and VM, formats 545-bit flits with credit flow control and sends them to the per-link endpoints (hfd_lk_ep) beside the SerDes; it also serves row gathers to the loader.

hfd_coll_credit_prod.summary: Collective link credit-flow contract block: producer, synchronisers, flight gate (HBM accelerator)
hfd_coll_credit_prod.about: Physical screening block of the collective link's credit contract: one receive-side credit producer, its PHY-side clock-domain synchronisers, a partner consumer and the transmit flight gate that limits in-flight flits.

hfd_coll_idle_tx.summary: Collective link transmit pacer: inserts idle flits for clock-offset tolerance (HBM accelerator)
hfd_coll_idle_tx.about: The transmit idle-insertion pacer of a collective link: inserts one idle slot per 1,024 so a sender running up to 200 ppm fast never overruns a plesiochronous (independently clocked) receiver.

hfd_coll_pkt_fifo_ii1.summary: Collective packet SRAM queue (545-bit, 256 deep) accepting one packet per cycle (HBM accelerator)
hfd_coll_pkt_fifo_ii1.about: One full-width collective packet queue (the receive buffer) built on SRAM macros with a full-rate refill, so the collective path accepts a packet every cycle. Reset enters through a local synchroniser.

hfd_gath_r25.summary: Gather station r25: merges two matrix-engine result streams onto the gather bus (HBM accelerator)
hfd_gath_r25.about: A forwarded-clock gather station on the matrix-engine to stream-unit result gather path. It takes two local 270-bit result taps (t0, t1) plus the incoming bus and packs them onto its output toward the stream unit. It also merges an already-gathered upstream bus (a2), producing the full 2,165-bit output.

hfd_gath_r9.summary: Gather station r9: merges two matrix-engine result streams onto the gather bus (HBM accelerator)
hfd_gath_r9.about: A forwarded-clock gather station on the matrix-engine to stream-unit result gather path. It takes two local 270-bit result taps (t0, t1) plus the incoming bus and packs them onto its output toward the stream unit.

hfd_hc.summary: DeepSeek hyper-connection unit quarter: mixes residual streams per layer (HBM accelerator)
hfd_hc.about: The DeepSeek-V4.1 hyper-connection (HC) unit: a quarter of 88 hyper-connection post-mix lane tiles (hfd_hc_tile_xl) on an 8 x 11 grid with broadcast and capture chains to its die faces. It applies the HC mixing of the residual streams between layers, fed from and returning to the stream-unit / VM side.

hfd_host_ingest.summary: Host KV-ingest master: writes GPU-prefilled KV cache into HBM decode layout (HBM accelerator)
hfd_host_ingest.about: Takes KV cache produced by GPU prefill from the host and translates it into the DeepSeek-V4.1 decode KV layout on the HBM write fabric, shared with decode write-back and the loader. A completion fence releases a slot to the decode scheduler only after all its writes are acknowledged.

hfd_idx_score.summary: Index scorer: scores streamed index keys against the query, one per HBM stack (HBM accelerator)
hfd_idx_score.about: The DeepSeek-V4.1 index scorer of one HBM stack (four per die). It receives FP4 index-key lines from the stack's stream service and query heads from the selector, and returns per-key score beats to the selector with credit flow. It is hardened as column taps of 4 lanes (variants lane4/8/12).

hfd_idx_sel_native_qend.summary: Index selector: quantises the query and picks the top-512 KV positions (HBM accelerator)
hfd_idx_sel_native_qend.about: The per-die indexer selector variant: quantises the query to FP4 for the scorers, lands score beats from the four stack scorers in SRAM FIFOs, and keeps the top 512 KV positions (ties to the lower id). It publishes the selection, with a quarter-end marker, for attention's KV fetch.

hfd_idx_t4_join.summary: Joins the four index-scorer column taps into one 16-lane score stream (HBM accelerator)
hfd_idx_t4_join.about: Atomic join of four 4-lane index-scorer taps back into the native 16-lane score beat. Each tap has an SRAM queue with 128 credits, so tap skew never loses a word; the joined beat goes to the selector.

hfd_index_q_b2.summary: Band b2 of the interim index-quarter transport stack toward the stream unit (HBM accelerator)
hfd_index_q_b2.about: One segment band (b2) of the interim index-quarter view hfd_index_q, a transport stack that carried lanes toward the stream unit (not the indexer itself). Being replaced by the attention-to-SU relay chain (hfd_att_su_relay).

hfd_lk_ep.summary: Per-link endpoint: connects the collective engine to one SerDes link with retry (HBM accelerator)
hfd_lk_ep.about: One endpoint per die-to-die SerDes link: it converts the collective engine's 545-bit flit and credit bus into link traffic through three hardened link-retry pipelines (replay on error/NAK).

hfd_loader.summary: Loader: host command-processor window, boot load and DMA front end to HBM (HBM accelerator)
hfd_loader.about: The loader block: the host's command-processor window and program fetch, the half-rate loader core, the memory port to the four HBM stack stream services, and the DMA engine front end (row moves between HBM and vector memory).

hfd_mcast_r5.summary: Multicast station r5: retimes the activation bus and taps it to two local consumers (HBM accelerator)
hfd_mcast_r5.about: A forwarded-clock multicast station on the 2,068-bit activation multicast bus from the vector-memory root to the matrix engines. It lands the bus into the local clock and drives two local tap outputs (t0, t1) and forwards the bus onward.

hfd_mcast_r6.summary: Multicast station r6: retimes the activation bus and taps it to two local consumers (HBM accelerator)
hfd_mcast_r6.about: A forwarded-clock multicast station on the 2,068-bit activation multicast bus from the vector-memory root to the matrix engines. It lands the bus into the local clock and drives two local tap outputs (t0, t1) and forwards the bus onward.

hfd_mcast_r6a.summary: Multicast station r6a: one half of the split r6 activation multicast station (HBM accelerator)
hfd_mcast_r6a.about: One of two halves of the split multicast station hfd_mcast_r6 (1,026-bit slice of the activation multicast bus from the vector-memory root to the matrix engines). It forwards its slice onward and taps it to two local consumers (t0, t1).

hfd_mcast_r6b.summary: Multicast station r6b: one half of the split r6 activation multicast station (HBM accelerator)
hfd_mcast_r6b.about: One of two halves of the split multicast station hfd_mcast_r6 (1,042-bit slice of the activation multicast bus from the vector-memory root to the matrix engines). It forwards its slice onward and taps it to two local consumers (t0, t1).

hfd_mcast_r7.summary: Multicast station r7: retimes the activation bus and taps it to two local consumers (HBM accelerator)
hfd_mcast_r7.about: A forwarded-clock multicast station on the 2,068-bit activation multicast bus from the vector-memory root to the matrix engines. It lands the bus into the local clock and drives two local tap outputs (t0, t1); it is the last station of its chain (no onward output).

hfd_meso_r35.summary: Mesochronous station r35: lands a forwarded-clock bus slice into the local clock (HBM accelerator)
hfd_meso_r35.about: A mesochronous termination station on a spine chain (hub-chain station): it captures a 512-bit forwarded-clock slice and lands it into the local clock through a small FIFO, ending the forwarded segment.

hfd_meso_r37.summary: Mesochronous station r37: lands a forwarded-clock bus slice into the local clock (HBM accelerator)
hfd_meso_r37.about: A mesochronous termination station on a spine chain (hub-chain station): it captures a 512-bit forwarded-clock slice and lands it into the local clock through a small FIFO, ending the forwarded segment.

hfd_mtp_x_stop.summary: MTP speculative-decode control with EOS / length / context stop handling (HBM accelerator)
hfd_mtp_x_stop.about: Multi-token-prediction (MTP) control: steps the draft/verify loop for a configured draft depth, issues commands, emits accepted tokens with their index, and stops on end-of-sequence, generation length or maximum context position.

hfd_quant.summary: Fused-path station: row norms, HC norms and FP8/FP4 block quantiser (HBM accelerator)
hfd_quant.about: The fused-path engine: takes fused records from the command processor and runs ROW_NORM and the DeepSeek hyper-connection norms on its internal stream unit, and forwards quantise/dequantise (FP8/FP4 block) records to the quantiser unit. Both read and write vector memory as packet clients.

hfd_router.summary: MoE router: pipelined exact top-k expert selection over router scores (HBM accelerator)
hfd_router.about: The MoE router block: a pipelined top-k selector that scans 16 router scores per cycle and returns the chosen experts exactly as the reference top-k does. On the generic-interface die, routing is also expressible as an indexer top-k.

hfd_sfu.summary: Special-function unit: runs the fused SwiGLU activation chain (HBM accelerator)
hfd_sfu.about: The special-function unit (SFU) engine: executes the fused SwiGLU chain for FFN/MoE layers. It stages operands from vector memory through its own packet client and station tap and drains results back to VM.

hfd_sfu_tile.summary: One SFU lane tile used to build the tiled special-function unit (HBM accelerator)
hfd_sfu_tile.about: A tiled restructure of the SFU quarter: one SFU lane hardened as a tile, replicated to build hfd_sfu instead of one flat block.

hfd_stn_r19.summary: Forward station r19: pipelines a forwarded-clock bus slice across the die (HBM accelerator)
hfd_stn_r19.about: A pass-through station on a forwarded-clock die bus: it captures the data on its incoming forwarded clock and re-launches it with the forwarded clock, so a long bus meets timing hop by hop. It has no local clock and no logic.

hfd_stn_r33.summary: Launch station r33: starts a forwarded-clock bus segment from the local clock (HBM accelerator)
hfd_stn_r33.about: A launch station: it registers a 512-bit bus slice on the local clock and starts a forwarded-clock segment (data plus forwarded clock) toward the next stations of the chain.

hfd_stn_r34.summary: Forward station r34: pipelines a forwarded-clock bus slice across the die (HBM accelerator)
hfd_stn_r34.about: A pass-through station on a forwarded-clock die bus: it captures the data on its incoming forwarded clock and re-launches it with the forwarded clock, so a long bus meets timing hop by hop. It has no local clock and no logic.

hfd_stn_r36.summary: Forward station r36: pipelines a forwarded-clock bus slice across the die (HBM accelerator)
hfd_stn_r36.about: A pass-through station on a forwarded-clock die bus: it captures the data on its incoming forwarded clock and re-launches it with the forwarded clock, so a long bus meets timing hop by hop. It has no local clock and no logic.

hfd_stn_r38.summary: Relay station r38: re-registers a bus slice on the local clock (HBM accelerator)
hfd_stn_r38.about: A relay station on a die bus chain: it re-registers a 512-bit slice on the local clock so the bus meets timing over long wires.

hfd_stn_r39.summary: Forward station r39: pipelines a forwarded-clock bus slice across the die (HBM accelerator)
hfd_stn_r39.about: A pass-through station on a forwarded-clock die bus: it captures the data on its incoming forwarded clock and re-launches it with the forwarded clock, so a long bus meets timing hop by hop. It has no local clock and no logic.

hfd_su_result_ingress.summary: Stream-unit result-ingress lane: buffers matrix-engine results arriving at the SU (HBM accelerator)
hfd_su_result_ingress.about: One lane of the matrix-engine to stream-unit result edge: a pin station plus an SRAM buffer that receives result words (data, row, fault) from the last relay of the gather path, reserves credits upstream and releases rows to the SU in order.

hfd_su_tile.summary: One stream-unit lane tile: a vector-pipeline lane plus its boundary registers (HBM accelerator)
hfd_su_tile.about: The replicated tile of the tiled stream-unit (SU) quarter: one SU lane with its broadcast, capture and accumulate registers. Many tiles are abutted to form a quarter that receives matrix-engine results and attention outputs and runs SU templates (multiply, add, special function, reduce, round). Its hardened sub-tile is hfd_su_tile_xl.

hfd_svc_SE_s0.summary: Segment 0 of the SE HBM stream service: maps and streams HBM pseudo-channel traffic (HBM accelerator)
hfd_svc_SE_s0.about: Segment 0 (counting along x) of the stream service for the south-east (also reused mirrored for north-east) HBM stack. It holds the service units whose pins sit in its strip (pseudo-channel pin units, matrix-engine port and arbiter, KV and index-key line assemblers, dispatcher), connected to neighbouring segments by registered wire-stage chains. hgi_att_record_g12_320.about: Physical build (about 320 um outline) of ot_hgi_att_record_adapter, the G12 front end of the attention unit. It takes a sequencer record (header, descriptors, position, ring/selected row counts) and hands the attention job to the controller via ot_hgi_att_issue and the row-list command to the row sources. Same RTL as its sibling outline variant.

hgi_att_rows_g12_120.summary: Attention row sources: emits the ordered list of KV rows to read (HBM accelerator)
hgi_att_rows_g12_120.about: Physical build (about 120 um outline) of ot_hgi_att_row_sources_p, the G12 row-metadata front end of attention. From a command (position, ring flag, window and selected-row counts) and a stream of selected row ids it emits ordered row references: the window ring rows (B) followed by selected rows (C). No KV data passes through it; existing gather readers fetch the rows.

hgi_idx_topk_full.summary: IDX.TOPK selector (k up to 2,048) built from two SRAM min-heaps (HBM accelerator)
hgi_idx_topk_full.about: Top-k unit as two banked-SRAM pipelined min-heaps with a drop filter and a registered merge, behind the die's registered top-k port. Selects up to 2,048 entries (e.g. KV positions for sparse attention) and writes the selection table used by indexed descriptors.

hgi_idx_topk_w8.summary: Production 8-wide IDX.TOPK selector: eight SRAM heaps (HBM accelerator)
hgi_idx_topk_w8.about: The production 8-wide top-k unit (ot_hgi_idx_topk_wreg, 8 input lanes, 8 heaps on 40 SRAM macros), with each heap a registered tile. Selects the top-k KV positions or experts and writes the result to VM.

hgi_idx_topk_wide.summary: 4-wide IDX.TOPK selector: four SRAM heaps in parallel (HBM accelerator)
hgi_idx_topk_wide.about: Top-k unit (ot_hgi_idx_topk_wreg, 4 input lanes, 4 heaps on 20 SRAM macros) that processes candidates in parallel for higher throughput than the 2-heap version.

hgi_mtp_native.summary: MTP master: DeepSeek speculative-decoding controller driven through the command processor (HBM accelerator)
hgi_mtp_native.about: The multi-token-prediction master of the generic HBM die: the native full-context DeepSeek draft/verify controller placed behind the command processor's MTP port. Verify-row argmax ids come from the argmax unit and collective merge via the CP rather than a local logit bus; it uses 17-bit DeepSeek token ids.

mtp_topk_f384.summary: Router top-K selector: picks 6 of 384 experts per position for DeepSeek MoE (HBM accelerator)
mtp_topk_f384.about: Pipelined MoE router top-K unit (384 experts, top 6, 16 scores per input beat) used in DSpark draft/verify passes on the HBM accelerator. Its expert ids feed the expert union and expert weight fetch from HBM.

ot_attn_bank_ew136.summary: 136-bit east-west register bank: pipeline stage for attention result pipes (HBM accelerator)
ot_attn_bank_ew136.about: A hardened 136-flop register bank with no logic (inputs on the W edge, outputs on the E edge), used as a wire-pipeline hop on east/west flows of the attention tiles. Right-sized for the 136-bit attention result pipes, which previously used 544-bit banks with unused bits. Banks are placed in chains so a long bus crosses the tile one short hop per cycle.

ot_attn_bank_ew544.summary: 544-bit east-west register bank: pipeline stage for wide attention buses (HBM accelerator)
ot_attn_bank_ew544.about: A hardened 544-flop register bank with no logic (inputs on the W edge, outputs on the E edge), used as a wire-pipeline hop on east/west flows of the attention tiles. Banks are placed in chains so a long bus crosses the tile one short hop per cycle.

ot_attn_bank_sn136.summary: 136-bit south-north register bank: pipeline stage for attention result pipes (HBM accelerator)
ot_attn_bank_sn136.about: A hardened 136-flop register bank with no logic (inputs on the S edge, outputs on the N edge), used as a wire-pipeline hop on south/north flows of the attention tiles. Right-sized for the 136-bit attention result pipes, which previously used 544-bit banks with unused bits. Banks are placed in chains so a long bus crosses the tile one short hop per cycle.

ot_attn_bank_sn544.summary: 544-bit south-north register bank: pipeline stage for wide attention buses (HBM accelerator)
ot_attn_bank_sn544.about: A hardened 544-flop register bank with no logic (inputs on the S edge, outputs on the N edge), used as a wire-pipeline hop on south/north flows of the attention tiles. Banks are placed in chains so a long bus crosses the tile one short hop per cycle.

ot_attn_tile_m6h1q.summary: Attention quad: four one-head attention leaves sharing one input register strip (HBM accelerator)
ot_attn_tile_m6h1q.about: The hardened element of the 16-head attention tile; four quads (first heads 0, 2, 8, 10) make one tile and receive the same input packet. A register strip in the middle registers the packet and drives the four leaves (two below, two mirrored above); each leaf computes attention for one head and drives outputs directly. Supports coarse clock gating of the leaves, woken by the quad's own input valids.

ot_dshbm_argmax_m.summary: Logit-row argmax epilogue for DSpark verify targets and Markov draft tokens (HBM accelerator)
ot_dshbm_argmax_m.about: Reduces a row of FP32 logits from the compute cluster's head matrix-vector epilogue to its argmax without a trip through shared memory. Used for verify targets and, with a Markov bias added, for DSpark's next draft token.

ot_dshbm_dspark_ctl.summary: DSpark speculative-decode control loop issuing prefill, draft and verify passes (HBM accelerator)
ot_dshbm_dspark_ctl.about: Persistent control engine that reproduces DeepSeek-V4.1's speculative generation loop step by step: writes tokens to the history ring, issues the compute cluster's prefill, draft and verify passes, and commits accepted tokens.

ot_dshbm_expert_union_m.summary: Builds the union of routed experts across positions of a multi-position MTP pass (HBM accelerator)
ot_dshbm_expert_union_m.about: In a verify or draft pass covering several positions, each position picks its own top-K experts. This block forms the union so each expert's weights stream once from HBM, and masks each expert's weight pass to only the positions that selected it.

ot_dsrom_hc_input_reader.summary: Reads this rank's slice of the four HC residual copies from vector memory for the MTP seed (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_hc_input_reader.about: Read client of the die's vector memory (VM) that fetches this tensor-parallel rank's 1,280 dimensions of the four BF16 hyper-connection residual copies (4 x 5,120). It streams the rows as eight-dimension beats to ot_dsrom_hc_mean_capture, which forms the MTP draft seed.

ot_dsrom_hc_mean_capture.summary: Averages the four HC residual copies at layers 37-39 into ECC SRAM as the MTP seed (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_hc_mean_capture.about: Mandatory DSpark seed capture: takes the four BF16 residual copies before the hyper-connection pre-mix at backbone layers 37, 38 and 39, sums them in FP32, scales by 0.25 and rounds to BF16. The three captures are held in SECDED-protected SRAM and delivered as an ordered frame stream to the head rank's seed join.

ot_dsrom_hc_secded_pipe.summary: Two-cycle SECDED decoder for the HC seed SRAM read path (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_hc_secded_pipe.about: Single-error-correct / double-error-detect decoder used on the protected SRAM reads of the HC seed capture and join blocks. It computes the syndrome in one registered stage and corrects and delivers the 64-bit payload in the next.

ot_dsrom_hc_seed_join.summary: Joins the three per-layer HC means on the head rank into the ordered MTP seed stream (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_hc_seed_join.about: On the head tensor-parallel rank, receives the three independently captured layer-37/38/39 means, stores them in three SECDED-protected SRAM macros and checks frame count, user, position and epoch. It then delivers the 120 frames in order as the seed input of the MTP draft (seed projection).

ot_dsrom_head_bundle_glue.summary: Glue logic of the lm_head bundle: input broadcast, B-element join and argmax compare tree (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_head_bundle_glue.about: Numerical glue extracted from ot_dsrom_head_bundle (the replicated lm_head unit holding 128 vocabulary rows in 10 ROM macros). It broadcasts the activation slices to the elements, joins the B element's partial sums, and runs the registered compare tree that merges the four A elements' argmax results.

ot_dsrom_head_elem_A.summary: lm_head A element: ROM rows x first 4,096 hidden dims, 16 BF16 MACs per ROM word (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_head_elem_A.about: One of the four A elements of an lm_head bundle (ot_dsrom_head_elem): streams 32 vocabulary rows of weights from a ping-pong pair of ROM macros, one word per cycle into 16 BF16 multipliers, over hidden dimensions 0-4,095. Its partial logits combine with the B element's and feed the bundle's argmax tree.

ot_dsrom_head_elem_B.summary: lm_head B element: hidden dims 4,096-5,119 for all 128 rows of a bundle (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_head_elem_B.about: The B element of an lm_head bundle (ot_dsrom_head_elem with padding): computes the last 1,024 hidden dimensions for all 128 vocabulary rows of the bundle, in an order that hands each A element its remaining partial sum just in time. Results join the A elements' logits through the bundle glue.

ot_dsrom_markov_embed_localcapture_pair.summary: Markov-embedding ROM lookup pair with direct macro-output capture for the DSpark draft (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_markov_embed_localcapture_pair.about: Two ROM banks holding DSpark's Markov token embeddings, read alternately with each macro output captured directly in a local flop. It looks up the embedding of the previous draft token, which the Markov draft head uses to bias the next draft token's logits.

ot_dsrom_markov_head_driver.summary: Drives the DSpark Markov draft head: embedding dots per vocab row and draft-token argmax (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_markov_head_driver.about: Replicated element of the head die's Markov draft head. It captures the previous draft token's Markov embedding once, reuses it across full-K dot products with 32 local vocabulary rows read from two ROM macros, and queues the resulting logit row for the argmax that picks the next draft token.

ot_dsrom_mtp_lrx_rtt.summary: Credit link receiver sized to the real relay round trip, for MTP sequencer links (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_mtp_lrx_rtt.about: Receiver end of the registered grant/credit link used between the head die's MTP sequencer and its neighbours (e.g. the collective slab). Its landing buffer depth matches the actual forward and return relay hop count, so the 512-bit token and seed streams run at full rate without overflow.

ot_dsrom_mtp_seed_ctl.summary: MTP seed projection controller: quantises the seed, drives the ROM matmul element (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_mtp_seed_ctl.about: Production controller of the DSpark seed projection (5,120 x 15,360 FP8 weights). It takes the 3 x 5,120 BF16 HC-mean seed, quantises it to FP8 blocks with two activation quantisers, holds them in four SRAMs, and drives the separately hardened ROM matmul element through registered pins while collecting its outputs.

ot_dsrom_ring_dyn_vehicle.summary: Core sequencer's per-position operand table in an 8-slot ring for MTP rollback (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_ring_dyn_vehicle.about: Standalone build of the v41x core sequencer's DYN table: per-position dynamic operand parameters (matmul sizes, base addresses, RoPE position) captured into an 8-slot ring with 17 read selectors. The ring lets speculative positions be discarded exactly when drafts are rejected.

ot_dsrom_su_fdiv_hr.summary: Half-rate FP32 divider: two cores on alternating clocks, one result per cycle (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_su_fdiv_hr.about: Two-core variant of the stream unit's correctly rounded FP32 divider (ot_dsrom_su_fdiv_f12), each core given two cycles per operation. Used for softmax normalisation.

ot_dsrom_su_fdiv_tile.summary: Pipelined correctly rounded FP32 divider tile for the stream unit (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_su_fdiv_tile.about: Tile of ot_dsrom_su_fdiv_f12: IEEE round-to-nearest-even division with gradual underflow; invalid operands or a zero divisor raise a fault. The non-restoring steps and normalisation are split across more pipeline stages.

ot_dsrom_su_hcpost_lane_pr.summary: Pin-registered lane of the hyper-connection post-mix pipeline in the stream unit (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_su_hcpost_lane_pr.about: One lane of the fused HC post-mix (out = BF16(y*post + sum of the four residual copies times mix coefficients)), wrapped with a flop on every input pin. Lanes are fed by a broadcast quarter of the HC post unit, which replaces several separate stream-unit passes through vector memory.

ot_dsrom_su_softmax_div_tile.summary: Softmax normalisation divider tile, one per lane (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_su_softmax_div_tile.about: Divider tile of the fused softmax with registered operands, one per stream-unit lane: divides each exponential by the row sum using the correctly rounded FP32 non-restoring divider.

ot_dsrom_su_softmax_exp_hr.summary: Half-rate FP32 exp for softmax: two cores on alternating clocks, one result per cycle (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_su_softmax_exp_hr.about: Variant of the softmax exponential tile built from two exp cores clocked on alternate cycles, giving each core two cycles per operation while keeping one result per cycle. Same bit-exact exp as ot_dsrom_su_softmax_exp6.

ot_dsrom_su_softmax_exp_tile.summary: FP32 exp tile of the fused softmax (several tiles per softmax block) (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_su_softmax_exp_tile.about: Registered-input tile of the softmax exponential (ot_dsrom_su_softmax_exp6): Cody-Waite range reduction plus a Horner polynomial, with every FP32 add on a pipelined adder. Nine instances sit in each softmax block of the stream unit.

ot_dsrom_su_swiglu_lane.summary: One lane of the fused SwiGLU expert activation pipeline in the stream unit (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_su_swiglu_lane.about: Element of the fused stream-unit chain for the MoE expert activation (clip, SiLU(gate) x up, then routing weight and requantisation). It replaces a sequence of separate stream-unit operations with one 1.2 GHz pipeline.

ot_dsrom_wfc_tokpipe_src.summary: Source package controller: issues positions through the die pipeline, verifies drafts (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_wfc_tokpipe_src.about: Wavefront package controller in SOURCE role (the embedding package): keeps per-user records in SRAM, issues known prompt and draft-token positions back to back through the layer-stage pipeline, reduces the returned results, rejects mismatching drafts and re-issues the corrected token.
ot_dsrom_wfc_tokpipe_src.family: DS ROM wavefront token pipeline controller

ot_dsrom_wfc_tokpipe_stg.summary: Stage package controller: forwards token steps between dies of the wavefront pipeline (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_wfc_tokpipe_stg.about: Same wavefront package controller in STAGE role (a downstream layer package): receives token steps over the registered die links, runs them through its stage and forwards them, honouring squashes from the source controller.
ot_dsrom_wfc_tokpipe_stg.family: DS ROM wavefront token pipeline controller

ot_dsrom_window_column_128.summary: 128-bit-wide memory column of the attention WINDOW KV staging buffer (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_window_column_128.about: One narrow (128-bit) column macro of ot_dsrom_window_stage_pipeline, the four-bank buffer that lands sliding-window KV rows from HBM. Writes are captured at the pins and reads return the row's next value, so the port timing matches the unregistered column.

ot_dsrom_window_column_256.summary: 256-bit-wide memory column (one KV code sector) of the WINDOW staging buffer (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_window_column_256.about: One 256-bit column of the WINDOW staging buffer, holding one code sector of the landed KV rows; each bank has 16 such sector columns plus the scale column. Writes are captured at the pins with replicated row enables.

ot_dsrom_window_column_halfwrite.summary: Full-capacity WINDOW staging column with a narrower write path (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_window_column_halfwrite.about: Alternative full-capacity column of the WINDOW staging buffer, with storage split into row groups and 16-bit write lanes to limit fan-out; its distributed variant spreads the same column across sub-tiles. The default build still selects the original column.

ot_dsrom_window_source_ctl.summary: Control of the WINDOW KV source: KV writer, tag mirror, 32-channel stream engine (DeepSeek ROM die)
ot_dsrom_window_source_ctl.about: Control leaf of the window source pipeline that fetches sliding-window KV for attention. It drives the staging buffer and row merge (separate neighbouring blocks) through explicit ports, tracks which rows are landed, and streams requests over 32 channels.

ot_gpu_rf_visibility_fence_p.summary: Visibility fence between MTP results and the host register-file write path (HBM accelerator).
ot_gpu_rf_visibility_fence_p.about: Forwards captured results as host writes and only reports an operation complete when the register-file owner acknowledges, with one operation and one write outstanding. This variant wraps the original between registered skid slices so die pins time cleanly. Sub-block of hfd_mtp.

ot_gpu_scratch_service_m.summary: 64 KiB shared scratch memory service of the MTP block, 64-byte beats (HBM accelerator).
ot_gpu_scratch_service_m.about: A 64 KiB shared memory of 1,024 aligned 64-byte beats served one transaction at a time, with read/write collisions serialised. A sub-block of the die's MTP block hfd_mtp.

ot_ha2_relay_tx_internal.summary: Experimental HA2 transmit relay: local launch stage and TX sharing one clock tree (HBM accelerator).
ot_ha2_relay_tx_internal.about: Internal-only test vehicle of the HA2 hub relay transmit path, where the local launch stage and the transmitter share one clock tree; the upstream slot source and credit/reset parents are outside it.

ot_ha2_truecredit_rx_phys.summary: Credit-based receiver for an HA2 all-reduce link: queues flits, returns credits (HBM accelerator).
ot_ha2_truecredit_rx_phys.about: Physical wrapper of the true-credit receiver: buffers arriving flits in a per-slot queue, presents them to the consumer and returns credits to the sender; read head is a registered two-level mux.

ot_ha2_truecredit_rx_s_phys.summary: HA2 all-reduce link receiver with its 64-deep queue in SRAM instead of flops (HBM accelerator).
ot_ha2_truecredit_rx_s_phys.about: Same ports and protocol as ot_ha2_truecredit_rx_phys, but the 64-deep receive queue sits in 1-read/1-write SRAM (2 x 64x512 macros per lane) with registered macro inputs and output.

ot_ha2_truecredit_tx_phys.summary: Credit-based sender for an HA2 all-reduce link: reserves receiver slots before sending (HBM accelerator).
ot_ha2_truecredit_tx_phys.about: Physical wrapper of the true-credit sender: a slot at the far receiver is reserved before a flit enters the unstallable hub flight, and credits return when the receiver frees it. Arrivals and returns land in pin registers.

ot_hbm_accel_dskv_wb_spec.summary: Writes each token's DeepSeek KV, index-key and window rows to HBM, MTP-rollback safe (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_dskv_wb_spec.about: Per-token KV / index-key writer for DeepSeek-V4.1 on every HBM stack: maps each row to a pseudo-channel and sector and issues the HBM writes. Window rows use a 256-slot ring (slot = position mod 256) so rows written by a rejected MTP draft cannot overwrite rows still needed; the index-key shadow is locked once decode starts.

ot_hbm_accel_dswin_rd.summary: Generates HBM read addresses for DeepSeek sliding-window KV rows, 17 sectors per row (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_dswin_rd.about: Read side of the window layout written by ot_hbm_accel_dskv_wb_spec. Driven by the speculative-state address generator, it turns each window or MTP-stage row request into its 17 pseudo-channel-local sector addresses (stack, PC, bank, column, row), one per cycle, using the same slot map as the writer.

ot_hbm_accel_smh_bdc.summary: SM leaf block-dot column: 2 FP8/FP4 block-dot lanes (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_smh_bdc.about: Hardened block-dot column of an SM leaf tile, used for the FP8/FP4 block-scaled weight formats. The leaf's operand stage lands in its input pins (south) and results leave north from the last pipeline register.

ot_hbm_accel_smh_be_eg.summary: Clock-gated SM column back end, east pins: lands, combines and stacks one column.s results (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_smh_be_eg.about: One per SM column, below the column: lands and deskews the gather lanes from the column's tiles, runs the column combine tree and streaming stack, and moves result lanes one column per cycle toward the front. This is the east-edge pin variant behind one clock gate (same netlist as be_wg).

ot_hbm_accel_smh_be_wg.summary: Clock-gated SM column back end, west pins: lands, combines and stacks one column.s results (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_smh_be_wg.about: Mirror of ot_hbm_accel_smh_be_eg (results leave on the other edge). Lands and deskews the column's gather lanes, runs the combine tree and streaming stack, and forwards results toward the SM front; one clock gate per back end.

ot_hbm_accel_smh_fc_b.summary: SM front-centre piece: one side's lower row bundles and x-write output (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_smh_fc_b.about: Child of the SM front_c strip, one per side. Lands the distributed line, builds the row-2 bundle output and the row-3 bundle handed to fc_bc, and drives the x-write bundle for the tile rows below.

ot_hbm_accel_smh_fc_bc.summary: SM front-centre piece: ring SRAMs, bulk copy and south-face channels (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_smh_fc_bc.about: Child of the SM front_c strip. Holds the ring SRAMs and bulk copy, the south-face descriptor/request/response channels and the first line skid that feeds the issue piece fc_is.

ot_hbm_accel_smh_fc_is.summary: SM front-centre piece: INT8 adapter, issue, s1 and op channel sink (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_smh_fc_is.about: Child of the SM front_c strip. Holds the second line skid, the INT8 line adapter with its output queue and format bypass, the pipelined issue, the op channel sink, release/retire landings, barrier outputs, s1 and the first distribution hop toward the row pieces.

ot_hbm_accel_smh_fc_t.summary: SM front-centre piece: one side's tile-row-0/1 row bundles (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_smh_fc_t.about: Child of the SM front_c strip, one per side (west and mirrored east). Lands the distributed line (second hop plus pads), unpacks it and builds the row bundles that go to the row-0 face register in fc_xl and out to tile row 1.

ot_hbm_accel_smh_fc_xl.summary: SM front-centre piece: tile row 1 x-write landing and row-0 face register (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_smh_fc_xl.about: Child of the SM front_c strip. Lands tile row 1's activation (x) write bundle at the north face, holds the first relay per side (west/east edges) and the row-0 face register.

ot_hbm_accel_smh_fc_xr.summary: SM front-centre piece: x-write relay 2 and line-copy relay, one per side (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_smh_fc_xr.about: Child of the SM front_c strip, placed once per side (west and mirrored east). Holds the second relay of the x-write bundle and one relay on that side's line copy and format bits on the way to fc_b.

ot_hbm_accel_smh_front_c.summary: Centre strip of the SM front: ring/bulk copy, line stream, issue and unpack (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_smh_front_c.about: Middle strip of the SM front: the ring buffer and bulk copy, the weight-line stream, the pipelined issue and s1 stage, unpack, and the row bundles for tile rows 1 and 2 plus tile row 1's x-write bundle. Being re-split into hardened children fc_bc, fc_is, fc_xl, fc_xr, fc_t and fc_b.

ot_hbm_accel_smh_front_n.summary: North strip of the SM front: north pins, op channel, x-write landing, tile row 0 (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_smh_front_n.about: Top of the three strips the SM front is cut into. Holds the north element pins (op channel source with its credits, x-write landing and decode, barrier) and drives tile row 0's row bundle and x-write bundle outputs.

ot_hbm_accel_smh_front_s.summary: South strip of the SM front: descriptor/request/response pins and result landing (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_smh_front_s.about: Bottom strip of the SM front: the south element pins (descriptor channel source, request channel sink, response chain), result lane landing and deskew, the result pin chains and tile row 3. Optionally qualifies gated results by each column's valid before reporting them.

ot_hbm_accel_smh_pt_e.summary: SM tile pass-through band, east: relay and launch registers for row bundles (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_smh_pt_e.about: Hardened pass-through band of the SM leaf tile on its east side: the third and launch registers that move the row bundle and x-write beat on to the next tile in the row.

ot_hbm_accel_smh_pt_w.summary: SM tile pass-through band, west: landing and leaf landings for row bundles (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_smh_pt_w.about: Hardened pass-through band of the SM leaf tile on its west side: lands the incoming row bundle, holds the second register stage and the landings that feed both leaves of the tile.

ot_hbm_accel_smh_tcc.summary: SM leaf BF16 column: 16 BF16 multiply lanes (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_smh_tcc.about: Hardened BF16 compute column of an SM leaf tile: the leaf's operand stage lands in input pin flops and feeds 16 BF16 lanes, with outputs from the column's last pipeline register. Paired with the block-dot column bdc in each leaf.

ot_hbm_accel_smh_tcl.summary: SM leaf BF16 column half: 8 BF16 lanes (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_smh_tcl.about: Finer split of the SM leaf's BF16 column into hardened 8-lane pieces; together with the 16-lane BF16 tree piece tct it replaces the single tcc column inside the leaf tile.

ot_hbm_accel_smh_tct.summary: SM leaf BF16 column tree: reduces the 16 BF16 lanes (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_smh_tct.about: Hardened piece of the SM leaf tile holding the 16-lane BF16 reduction tree that follows the BF16 lane pieces (tcl), in the finer split of the leaf's BF16 column.

ot_hbm_accel_smh_tile_eg.summary: Clock-gated SM compute tile, east-side pin variant, one per leaf (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_smh_tile_eg.about: Production master of the SM leaf tile for tiles east of the front: the leaf's x-store SRAMs, operand registers, BF16 and block-dot column logic, the column select, and pass-through registers that move row bundles one tile per cycle along the row. Wrapped with one clock gate so an idle tile stops its clock; same netlist as tile_wg with bundle pins on the opposite edges.

ot_hbm_accel_smh_tile_wg.summary: Clock-gated SM compute tile, west-side pin variant, one per leaf (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_smh_tile_wg.about: Mirror of ot_hbm_accel_smh_tile_eg for tiles west of the SM front (row bundles enter east, leave west). Holds the leaf's x-store SRAMs, BF16 and block-dot columns and pass-through registers behind one clock gate; being rebuilt as a hierarchy of hardened sub-blocks (xs, tcc/bdc columns, pass-through bands).

ot_hbm_accel_smh_xs.summary: SM leaf front: landing flops, x-store SRAMs and operand registers (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_accel_smh_xs.about: Hardened sub-block of the SM leaf tile. Lands the row bundle in pin flops, applies the x-write position strap rotation, holds the leaf's four activation (x) store SRAMs and registers the operands fed to the BF16 and block-dot columns.

ot_hbm_clock_reset_collars_rs.summary: Reset collars: per-endpoint reset synchronisers releasing reset into each clock domain (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_clock_reset_collars_rs.about: Clock/reset collars for 17 reset endpoint regions: each has a 2-flop synchroniser (async assert, sync deassert) qualified by power-on, PLL reset and lock, then a registered fan-out tree. Gives every downstream flop a clean, timed reset release.

ot_hbm_collective_vm_publication.summary: Publishes received FP32 collective results into vector memory with ECC (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_collective_vm_publication.about: Writes collective results (FP32, up to 4,096 elements) into vector memory (VM) through a request/response port, protected with SECDED ECC, and grants a stable read lease only after the write ACK and visibility completion. Faults are reported separately.

ot_hbm_idx_ehash_ds.summary: Hashes DeepSeek lookup keys into table row IDs for HBM-resident tables (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_idx_ehash_ds.about: DeepSeek binding of the hash unit: per command (op, layer, slot) it applies multiplier / prime / offset hash parameters and emits row IDs and columns for tables stored in HBM. Arithmetic is the shipped hash unchanged.

ot_hbm_index_global_order.summary: Merges every die's sorted top-k candidate list into one global order for sparse attention (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_index_global_order.about: Merges the ascending candidate lists published by all 96 tensor-parallel ranks into one global ordering using minimum-ID comparison levels. Reads come from checked link (TU) publication storage; its output is the selected key set the indexer hands to attention.

ot_hbm_link_retry_pipeline.summary: Die-to-die link retry pipeline: ACK/NAK tracking and replay pacing (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_link_retry_pipeline.about: Link-layer retry engine: coalesces cumulative ACKs, keeps NAKs sticky until captured, and updates replay state in registered steps so feedback never reaches the forward payload combinationally. A coordinated reset starts a new session so stale traffic cannot survive.

ot_hbm_native_ar_token_join.summary: Joins the two 16-SM command-processor halves into the on-die AR token loop (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_native_ar_token_join.about: Connects the two command-processor halves (16 SMs each) to the native on-die autoregressive token loop, checks completion identity and produces the host token records.

ot_hbm_native_candidate_format.summary: Packs index candidate tuples into link payloads, 15 x 34-bit slots per payload (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_native_candidate_format.about: Formatter on the send side of the indexer's candidate exchange: packs candidate tuples into 15 literal 34-bit slots per link (TU) payload, keeping the full header and marking the last payload of each quarter.

ot_hbm_native_candidate_parse.summary: Unpacks received link payloads back into 15 index candidate slots (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_native_candidate_parse.about: Receive-side decoder matching ot_hbm_native_candidate_format: splits each link payload into its 15 candidate slots with ready/valid flow control, keeps invalid/padding slots explicit, and signals quarter completion only after the final slot is accepted.

ot_hbm_native_frame_station_rb.summary: Frame station (registered boundary) multicasting a held frame to NO branches (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_native_frame_station_rb.about: Base registered-boundary frame station: every pin is flop-to-flop. Holds one frame, multicasts it to NO branches with held-valid / pulsed-ready handshakes, collects protected receipts and releases the frame after all branches ACK.

ot_hbm_native_frame_station_rb_NO3.summary: Frame station multicasting one held frame to 3 branches with checked receipts (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_native_frame_station_rb_NO3.about: Registered-boundary station that holds one full frame (data + frame header + owner), sends it to 3 branches and releases it only after every branch acknowledges the exact owner and frame. Built hierarchically from four 8-word and one 5-word slice tiles plus a hub; variants HALF / SAFE / split are alternative builds of the same station.

ot_hbm_native_index_control.summary: Indexer metadata controller: key layer/row tracking, prefetch and write-back fences (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_native_index_control.about: Dynamic metadata controller of the indexer inside the command processor: tracks the key layer and allocated rows, matches prefetch acceptance, and enforces the paired write-back visibility fence before keys are read. The enclosing command processor owns the VM lease; query credit and output joins are separate blocks.

ot_hbm_native_index_query_credit.summary: Passes FP32 index queries to the top-k selector under a four-credit flow control (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_native_index_query_credit.about: Adapts the ready/valid FP32 query stream from its source to the native index selector's four-credit pulse interface. Credits are set at reset and never regenerated mid-frame.

ot_hbm_native_mtp_emit_queue.summary: Queues tokens accepted by MTP for delivery to the host (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_native_mtp_emit_queue.about: Output queue for multi-token-prediction decode: holds accepted tokens tagged by generated-token index and signals completion only after the last accepted token has reached the host.

ot_hbm_norm_engine_view.summary: RMSNorm engine (64 lanes, D=5120) with registered pins (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_norm_engine_view.about: Pin-registered physical view of the fused RMSNorm engine: a fixed-schedule stream (valid + data) that reads the residual and gain, computes the mean square, rsqrt and scaling, and outputs BF16. Being rebuilt as 8 hardened 8-lane group tiles (grp8 / gtile8) plus a thin top.

ot_hbm_norm_grp8.summary: 8-lane group of the RMSNorm engine: square, scale and partial sum with x/gain SRAMs (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_norm_grp8.about: Replicated element of the split RMSNorm engine: per lane the input mix, square, scale and BF16 output register; one x SRAM and one gain SRAM for the group; and the in-group part of the sum tree. The top combines the groups' sums and broadcasts the reciprocal RMS back.

ot_hbm_norm_gtile8.summary: RMSNorm 8-lane group tile: grp8 plus alignment stages and planned pin faces (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_norm_gtile8.about: Hardened group tile for the rebuilt RMSNorm engine: one ot_hbm_norm_grp8 with its own reset synchroniser, pin-flop boundary and extra alignment register stages on the outer data inputs and outputs, so the tiles can abut in the engine top.

ot_hbm_production_clock_digital_body.summary: Production boot/reset sequencer body behind the PLL boundary (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_production_clock_digital_body.about: Full production power-on and reset body: clocks and lock come from the analog PLL boundary, and the sequencer (with its POR release mask) drives the reset collars. Readiness inputs from die endpoints enter as plain inputs.

ot_hbm_token_loop.summary: On-die decode loop: next-token doorbell, stop conditions and host token FIFO (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_token_loop.about: Replaces a per-token host doorbell: the host posts one job (first token/position, token count, EOS, max position) and every die runs the same deterministic loop off the shared merged argmax, issuing the next step on-die. Only die 0 posts token records to the host through a FIFO. Supports AR and MTP decode.

ot_hbm_tu_retry_phy_port.summary: Binds the die-to-die link PHY to the core retry logic with credit pulses (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_tu_retry_phy_port.about: Port between the link PHY and the core: converts core credits into real pulses and takes a PHY session epoch from link management after both clocks reset and training completes, without sampling multi-bit values across clocks.

ot_hbm_w2_stn_hub_NO2.summary: Control hub of the 2-branch frame station: phase, receipts, release (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_w2_stn_hub_NO2.about: The station glue extracted as its own hard block: phase state machine, ACK / receipt / permission banks, release logic and status for the 2-branch frame station. Connects to the five payload slice tiles through registered seam ports.

ot_hbm_w2_stn_hub_NO3.summary: Control hub of the 3-branch frame station: phase, receipts, release (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_w2_stn_hub_NO3.about: The station glue extracted as its own hard block: phase state machine, ACK / receipt / permission banks, release logic and status for the 3-branch frame station. Connects to the five payload slice tiles through registered seam ports.

ot_hbm_w2_stn_slice5_NO2.summary: 5-word payload slice tile of the 2-branch frame station (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_w2_stn_slice5_NO2.about: Hardened word-group slice of the hierarchical frame station with 2 output branches: input pin capture, protected word registers with ECC check and verdict, the group reduction register and the 2 output launch copies for 5 payload words. A station uses four 8-word slices and one 5-word slice around the hub.

ot_hbm_w2_stn_slice5_NO3.summary: 5-word payload slice tile of the 3-branch frame station (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_w2_stn_slice5_NO3.about: Hardened word-group slice of the hierarchical frame station with 3 output branches: input pin capture, protected word registers with ECC check and verdict, the group reduction register and the 3 output launch copies for 5 payload words. A station uses four 8-word slices and one 5-word slice around the hub.

ot_hbm_w2_stn_slice8_NO2.summary: 8-word payload slice tile of the 2-branch frame station (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_w2_stn_slice8_NO2.about: Hardened word-group slice of the hierarchical frame station with 2 output branches: input pin capture, protected word registers with ECC check and verdict, the group reduction register and the 2 output launch copies for 8 payload words. A station uses four 8-word slices and one 5-word slice around the hub.

ot_hbm_w2_stn_slice8_NO3.summary: 8-word payload slice tile of the 3-branch frame station (HBM accelerator)
ot_hbm_w2_stn_slice8_NO3.about: Hardened word-group slice of the hierarchical frame station with 3 output branches: input pin capture, protected word registers with ECC check and verdict, the group reduction register and the 3 output launch copies for 8 payload words. A station uses four 8-word slices and one 5-word slice around the hub.

ot_hcoll_port.summary: One port of the switched collective endpoint: SRAM queues, arbiter, credits, TX/RX staging (HBM accelerator).
ot_hcoll_port.about: Hardened once and replicated 8x in hfd_coll. It holds the partial and result transmit queues, the arbiter (partials first) with the switch-ingress credit counter, transmit/receive wire-delay stages, serializer pacing and the receive buffer, all in 18 SRAM macros.

ot_hdc_accept.summary: Speculative-decoding accept unit: checks draft tokens against verify argmaxes (HBM accelerator).
ot_hdc_accept.about: Takes the step's pending token and draft tokens per position slot and the main model's verify argmax per slot, and decides how many drafts are accepted and which token comes next. Model-agnostic: used for DeepSeek-V4.1 MTP and for Qwen3.

ot_hdc_v41_fh_ctl.summary: Control view of the fused DSpark draft head: sequencing and narrow retirement (DeepSeek ROM die).
ot_hdc_v41_fh_ctl.about: Hardened wrapper of the fused head's top controller (ot_hdc_v41_fh_head_top) exposing only the control ports; the lanes retire their own data and the checked endpoint is a separate view. It has no logic of its own. Belongs to the fused DSpark draft head, which produces the speculative draft tokens.

ot_hdc_v41_fh_ep_view.summary: Checked endpoint of the fused DSpark draft head: aggregates faults/permissions on results (DeepSeek ROM die).
ot_hdc_v41_fh_ep_view.about: Hardened view of the fused head's checked endpoint (ot_hdc_v41_fh_vm_endpoint_ctx), the registered fault aggregation and permission check on what the head writes back to vector memory. Pure wrapper, no logic of its own. Belongs to the fused DSpark draft head, which produces the speculative draft tokens.

ot_hdc_v41_fh_hquad.summary: Half-quadrant of the fused DSpark draft head: 8 SRAM lanes with FP32 add and argmax (DeepSeek ROM die).
ot_hdc_v41_fh_hquad.about: One of 8 identical instances (a strap picks the lane half) that replace 4 quadrants. Each holds 8 hardened SRAM lane leaves, the capture + FP32 add lanes, fused/plain result select and argmax leaves; inputs land on flops and all outputs leave flops. Belongs to the fused DSpark draft head, which produces the speculative draft tokens.

ot_hdc_v41_fh_sram_lane_hardened.summary: One SRAM lane leaf of the fused DSpark draft head, with its request/return registers (DeepSeek ROM die).
ot_hdc_v41_fh_sram_lane_hardened.about: The hardened per-lane SRAM macro wrapper used 64 times in the fused head (8 per half-quadrant), with request registers at the macro pins and a registered return path. Belongs to the fused DSpark draft head, which produces the speculative draft tokens.

ot_hdc_v41x_idx_chunk_el.summary: One 8-head chunk of the DeepSeek indexer score engine, built from 32 hardened slices (HBM accelerator).
ot_hdc_v41x_idx_chunk_el.about: The indexer's hardened element: one 8-head chunk with its head base as a strap, used 4 times per score-engine column with a tail and front end. Internally it is columns of 8 ot_hdc_v41x_idx_hslice slices; query beats, keys and running head sums travel down each column.

ot_hdc_v41x_idx_hslice.summary: One head x one key slice of the DeepSeek indexer chunk, systolic (HBM accelerator).
ot_hdc_v41x_idx_hslice.about: Identical hardened slice of an indexer chunk: it loads its head's query when the head strap matches, multiplies and accumulates against keys passing down the column, and passes beats and the running sum to the next slice on registered seams.

ot_hdc_v41x_sfu_chain.summary: Sigmoid chain sub-tile (exp, denominator, numerator, divide) inside a stream-unit SFU lane (HBM accelerator).
ot_hdc_v41x_sfu_chain.about: Hardened sub-tile holding the SFU lane's sigmoid chain, sized to fit inside the lane outline. Every input is a pin register and every output a register; produces the same words as the in-lane chain two cycles later.

ot_hgi_argmax18_m.summary: Local argmax over this die's logit shard, 18-bit global token id (HBM accelerator)
ot_hgi_argmax18_m.about: ARGMAX.LOCAL engine (unit 7): scans a logit row beat by beat and returns the index of the largest value (lowest index on ties, first NaN flagged), offset by rank times shard size to give an 18-bit global id. Fed by ot_hgi_argmax_record; the result is merged across dies by COLL.ARGMAX_MERGE.

ot_hgi_argmax_record.summary: Record adapter: decodes ARGMAX.LOCAL records onto the argmax unit's command port (HBM accelerator)
ot_hgi_argmax_record.about: Unit 7: reads one FP32 logit row from VM sector by sector through a VM packet client and feeds it to ot_hgi_argmax18_m, which returns the global token id (lowest index on ties). Decode and handshake only, between the command-processor sequencer and the engine.

ot_hgi_att_issue.summary: Decodes ATT.QK / ATT.PV records into attention-controller jobs (HBM accelerator)
ot_hgi_att_issue.about: Consumer of the G12 attention record adapter: turns each attention record into the attention controller's job word (QK or PV mode, lanes, slices, head dim, row count). The row list itself goes separately to the G12 row sources. Decode and handshake only.

ot_hgi_att_sector_codec.summary: Encodes 256-bit sectors to FP8 codes with validity masks for KV rows (HBM accelerator)
ot_hgi_att_sector_codec.about: Exact sector codec on the attention/KV path: converts one 256-bit sector of values into FP8 (E4M3) codes plus per-element mask and out-of-range flags, with an output capture register; the SRAM it feeds stays outside. Verified exhaustively over all BF16 input patterns and raw FP8.

ot_hgi_coll_decode.summary: Decodes collective (COLL) record headers into collective engine commands (HBM accelerator)
ot_hgi_coll_decode.about: Engine-side decoder for COLL records (all-reduce, all-gather, top-k merge, argmax merge, group reduce, row gather): queues one command and hands it to the existing collective/gather datapath; malformed commands retire as faults.

ot_hgi_coll_row_formatter.summary: Formats ROW_GATHER requests: row ids to owner dies and slots (HBM accelerator)
ot_hgi_coll_row_formatter.about: ROW_GATHER list/owner formatter of the collective engine: maps each requested row id to its owner die and position, using the current row reader, and fault-terminates on bad ids. Does not store rows itself.

ot_hgi_coll_tkm.summary: Top-k merge sink: merges per-die top-k streams into a global 2,048 list (HBM accelerator)
ot_hgi_coll_tkm.about: Hardware COLL.TOPK_MERGE sink: receives per-rank top-k streams on 4 delivery lanes (SRAM FIFOs) and inserts them into a 2,048-entry sorted insertion array to form the group-wide top-k. Built from ot_hgi_coll_tkm_tile segments.

ot_hgi_coll_tkm_tile.summary: Tile of the top-k merge insertion array (one block of positions) (HBM accelerator)
ot_hgi_coll_tkm_tile.about: Hardened segment of the COLL.TOPK_MERGE insertion chain with its own clock tree and registered seams; tiles are chained to form ot_hgi_coll_tkm's 2,048-entry array.

ot_hgi_cp.summary: Die command processor: config path plus record sequencer that runs each token's program (HBM accelerator)
ot_hgi_cp.about: Top of the command processor: the configuration path (host CFG window, commit with busy/range checks, model vocabulary and context limits) plus the record sequencer ot_hgi_seq.
